decisions.decision: Repository is a source container, not the reusable unit.
Reuse shape is selected before extraction or normalization.
One authoritative owner per table and migration.
Postgres is the default for new Actionist-owned transactional data, not a universal module invariant.
One HostContract can absorb identity, settings, navigation and visual boundaries across all reuse shapes.
Design preference axes have sufficiently low effective dimension for a short adaptive protocol.
Donor applications can reliably render below the host frame without destructive adaptation.
Composition eliminates incompatibilities deterministically before model selection.
Select the representative Sprint 3 pilot industry/workflow after Sprint 2 convergence.
